title: 6 ways mushrooms can save the world | Paul Stamets | TED
summary: Mycologist Paul Stamets presents six ways mycelium and fungi could help save the world, in an 18-minute TED talk. Topics include environmental cleanup and other applications of fungi.
why: Recommended as an engaging, down-to-earth talk on the world-changing potential of fungi.
